Mickey Sand Dollar Collection – A Coastal Disney Escape Bring the wonder of Disney and the serenity of the shore together with the Mickey Sand Dollar Collection. Inspired by sunlit beaches and ocean breezes, this collection blends coastal charm with the playful spirit of Mickey Mouse. Featuring an elegant sand dollar pattern with hidden Mickey silhouettes, these rugs capture the essence of a magical seaside adventure. Whether you're styling an oceanfront retreat, a relaxing patio, or a cozy Disney-themed space, this collection is designed to transform any area into a dreamy getaway. Woven with precision in Belgium, these premium polypropylene flatweave rugs offer both beauty and durability. The weather-resistant, fade-resistant, and stain-resistant materials ensure they stand up to sunlight, moisture, and everyday foot traffic. Designed for both indoor and outdoor use, they’re perfect for patios, porches, living spaces, and kids’ play areas. The low-pile, non-shedding texture provides a soft yet sturdy surface, making them kid-friendly, pet-friendly, and easy to maintain. With a calming palette of sandy neutrals, soft blues, and warm browns, the Mickey Sand Dollar Collection blends effortlessly into coastal, nautical, and modern décor styles. Whether you're reminiscing about a trip to Disney’s Castaway Cay or dreaming of your next oceanside escape, this collection brings the magic of Mickey and the beauty of the sea into your home.
